about: Golden cases for M4, speech to text: read speech in Italian (Multilingual LibriSpeech) and English (LibriSpeech test-clean), 30 clips each spread over the test file, both CC-BY-4.0 (see NOTICE.md). The audio is not committed: `pixi run eval-data -- speech` rebuilds it into .eval-data/ from the pinned files and checks each clip against `wav_sha256`. Scored by word error rate against `reference` after normalisation (`fm_agent::eval::wer`). `recorded` holds real readers' transcripts.
